title: Wendell and the Terminal
author: Elodie Eriksen
blurb: Lior Voss, the last human technician on an automated relay station, has spent three years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
